comment: MTG_LINE_REPAY (docs/design/mana-completeness-oracle.md section 14; the Dragons mana-clean ENUM-GAP, 1,601 of its 1,691 flags). Five mana on T4: Mountain, Mind Stone, Gruul Turf ({T}: {R}{G}) and a fresh Haven of the Spirit Dragon, with Dragonspeaker Shaman out. {Urza's Incubator, Inferno of the Star Mounts} pays only as the Incubator's {3} off the Turf's {G} + the Haven's {C} + Mind Stone with the Turf's {R} floating, then Inferno ({4}{R}{R} less 2 less 2 = {R}{R}) off that {R} and the Mountain. The per-cast payer spent the Mountain on the {3} and left the Turf alone for {R}{R}, and the enumerator's sequential walk (the same payer) kept the plan off the menu, so the search never saw it. With the line re-pay the walk re-makes the {3} when the Inferno's payment fails, the plan is on the menu, and the search plays it. With MTG_LINE_REPAY=0 the T4 line is Inferno alone. (The library is uncastable Hellkites so no land drop or cheap draw changes the board.)
expect_log_sequence: T4 MAIN_1 CAST_SPELL Inferno of the Star Mounts
